modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: All carry-on baggage must be declared at the check-in counter and carry a Jazeera Airways carry-on tag.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Maximum carry-on dimensions: 55 cm x 40 cm x 20 cm.

infant.value: Passengers travelling with an infant in Economy may carry 1 additional piece of hand baggage up to 10 kg, within the standard size limits.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Jazeera's checked allowance depends on the fare you buy.

allowance_by_fare.value: Basic: no checked baggage. Comfort: 20kg, 1 piece. Flex: 30kg, 2 pieces. Flex Plus: 40kg, 2 pieces.

economy_limits.value: Economy: max 2 pieces, total up to 40 kg depending on fare; max 32 kg and 158 cm (height + width + depth) per piece.

business_allowance.value: Business class: max 3 pieces, total up to 60 kg; max 32 kg and 158 cm (height + width + depth) per piece.

infants.value: Infants have no checked baggage allowance.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: Jazeera's conditions of carriage set out the options when it cancels a flight or fails to operate it reasonably according to schedule through its own fault.

rebooking_refund.value: If Jazeera cancels a flight, or fails to operate it reasonably according to schedule because of its fault, you can choose to be carried on its next available flight at no additional charge, take a credit for the fare usable within 1 year, or get a refund. Refunds are given within 7 working days for cash and 15 working days for credit after your request.

eu261.value: Where Regulation (EC) 261/2004 applies, passengers are offered assistance and may be entitled to compensation for cancellation, except where it is caused by extraordinary circumstances.

counter_times.value: Check-in desks open three hours before and close promptly 60 minutes before the scheduled departure time; missing the deadline can mean your reservation is cancelled without refund or credit.

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Standard seats, preferred location seats, and extra legroom seating options are available depending on aircraft and cabin class

reserved_or_random.value: Reserve a specific seat in advance for a fee or free depending on fare class, or receive a free seat assignment during online check-in

family_seating.value: Children traveling with an accompanying adult are seated together during advance seat reservation or at check-in
